label: 左向きに紹介している女の子
prompt: Use case: illustration-story / identity-preserve character asset. Reference image is a visual reference for character identity, costume, pose and painterly style, NOT a background to reproduce. Create ONE isolated character cutout asset on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background (RGBA alpha); no colored paper, no white rectangle, no checkerboard printed into pixels, no scenery, no speech balloon, no calendar, no text, no frame, no ground shadow. Match the attached Japanese children's book illustration closely: warm watercolor/gouache texture, fine soft dark-brown outlines, gentle natural proportions, expressive brown eyes, delicate shading, not glossy 3D and not anime redesign. Keep one consistent character identity. Girl: chestnut bob hair, yellow star hairclip, coral cardigan with small buttons, cream shirt, teal pleated skirt. Boy: tousled short brown hair, blue zip-front hoodie over cream shirt. Final square 1536x1536 composition, character large with a small clear transparent margin around the entire subject. Never crop head, hair, fingers or required objects. Recreate ONLY the large narrator girl at the RIGHT foreground. Waist-up introduction pose, standing at screen right and looking/turning toward SCREEN LEFT. Her eyes and friendly open speaking mouth face LEFT; open palm extends toward the LEFT side, presenting a scene there. Match her identity, yellow star hairclip, chestnut bob, coral cardigan, cream shirt and upper teal skirt. Show the full head, arms and entire presenting hand/fingers; intentional straight waist/hip crop only along lower edge. One girl only, no backpack, no walking girl, no speech balloon, no timeline.
